metric: planBefore/planAfter pairs from Calcite's current rule tests, translated to SQL, proved equivalent; 1 genuine Calcite non-equivalence refuted with a DuckDB counterexample, 204 unknown. 75 of the 168 pairs new to every other corpus are proved.
caveats: Calcite commit 2d28ce3 (2026-09-30). 502 of 1016 tests translate exactly; 182 leave the plan unchanged (not rewrites) and 332 are skipped with reasons (tests/fixtures/calcite_mined/skipped.jsonl). 334 of the 502 overlap SQLSolver, QED or R-Bot, whose pairs rules were developed against (tuned on test); the 168 new pairs were not used for development, except that the set-operation rules (src/kumosql/setop_rules.py) were written after reading the 29 new set-operation pairs in the failing-tests triage, 19 of which they prove.
correctness: 0 false proofs; every proof and refutation re-run on 30 random DuckDB databases
held_out: 75/168 on pairs new to every other corpus; 19 of those 75 were seen while developing the set-operation rules, so 56/168 is the unseen figure
